chunks: "Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, begins by looking at the visitors of the grave of al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام on the eve of ʿArafah."
It was said to him: "Before His looking at the people of the standing-place?" He said: "Yes."
It was said to him: "And how is that?" He said: "Because among those are children of zina, and among these there are no children of zina."

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْمَوْقِفِ: the people at the standing-place, i.e. those gathered at ʿArafah
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِالنَّظَرِ: with divine regard or merciful attention
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted is He; a formula of divine glorification
key_terms.زُوَّارِ: visitors, specifically those who perform ziyārah
key_terms.قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about the virtue of visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn’s grave on the eve of ʿArafah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the special merit of visiting the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام on the eve of ʿArafah, describing a unique divine regard toward such visitors. It emphasizes the elevated spiritual rank of these zuwwār in comparison to the people gathered at ʿArafah.
